mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (current level below prior month) signals monetary easing that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with declining FEDFUNDS or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points (to >5.0%) signals labor market deterioration, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with UNRATE >5.0% after 0.3pp rise or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above 3-month moving averages signal robust consumer demand, elevating corporate profit expectations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with both HOUST and RSAFS above 3-month moving averages or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with INDPRO below 6-month moving average or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above its 12-month average signals persistent inflation, prompting monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with CPIAUCSL above 12-month moving average or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 1800.0 thousand units signals weak residential demand, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with HOUST < 1800.0 or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payrolls growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment decline (UNRATE) above 3-month moving averages signal labor market strength, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with both PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling above 3-month moving averages or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) trend (current level above prior month) signals manufacturing expansion, boosting corporate profits and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with rising INDPRO or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
